label: play: flyers, the brother, a float
js: (() => { game.hold(true); game.G.autoPause = false; game.start({ players: 1, who: 'tommy', level: 'easy', go: true }); const w = game.world(); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) CJ.sim.spawnFlyer(w); game.step(1.5); game.put(-3, 0, { ground: 0, face: 1 }); game.call(); game.step(1.0); game.put(3.5, 9, { face: 1 }); game.G.jumpQ = 1; game.step(0.5); return JSON.stringify(game.state().p); })()

label: power: coins
js: (() => { const w = game.world(); game.step(1.5); CJ.sim.spawnBall(w, w.hero.x, w.hero.y + 0.6); game.step(0.4); return JSON.stringify(game.state().flyers); })()

label: castle
js: (() => { game.start({ players: 1, who: 'teddy', level: 'normal', round: 2, go: true }); game.step(0.5); game.put(-1, 9.6, { face: -1 }); game.G.jumpQ = 1; game.step(0.3); return 'ok'; })()

label: city
js: (() => { game.start({ players: 2, level: 'easy', round: 3, go: true }); game.step(0.5); return 'ok'; })()

label: rocket + dizzy
js: (() => { game.start({ players: 1, who: 'teddy', level: 'easy', round: 4, go: true }); game.step(0.5); const w = game.world(); CJ.sim.bump(w, { kind: 'robot' }); game.step(0.6); return 'ok'; })()

label: clear celebration
js: (() => { game.start({ players: 1, who: 'teddy', level: 'easy', go: true }); const w = game.world(); w.candies.forEach((c, i) => { if (i < 23) CJ.sim.grab(w, c); }); CJ.sim.grab(w, w.candies[23]); game.step(1.2); return w.phase; })()
